rows.label: Nothing installed in the cluster
rows.full: Runs from your laptop with get/list only; nothing installed in the cluster

Shoalcheck.note: get and list from your kubeconfig; no agent, operator or Helm chart

Kubescape.note: CLI scans the live cluster via kubeconfig, agentless; node-level host checks need the in-cluster operator.

Trivy.note: `trivy k8s` uses your kubeconfig, but by default runs a node-collector Job in the cluster; disabling it drops node checks.

Popeye.note: Runs with your kubeconfig and get/list RBAC; read-only. Optional in-cluster CronJob mode.

Kubecost.note: Installed in-cluster via Helm; even the kubectl-cost CLI requires that in-cluster deployment.

Komodor.note: Requires the Komodor agent (Helm) in every cluster, connected to Komodor's SaaS.

Chkk.note: Zero-install CLI collects via kubeconfig but uploads to Chkk SaaS for analysis; continuous mode uses an in-cluster connector.

rows.label: One pass, five lenses
rows.full: One pass covers security, reliability, cost, compliance (CIS) and topology

Shoalcheck.note: security, reliability, cost, compliance and topology in a single read

Kubescape.note: Security plus CIS/NSA/MITRE compliance and some probe/limit hygiene controls; no cost or service map found.

Trivy.note: Vulnerabilities, misconfigurations, secrets, RBAC; CIS/NSA/PSS compliance reports. No cost or service map found.

Popeye.note: Hygiene, reliability and some security lints; usage vs requests. No CIS, dollar cost or service map found.

Kubecost.note: Cost allocation, efficiency and right-sizing only; no security or CIS compliance features found.

Komodor.note: Reliability violations, upgrade/EOL checks, cost allocation and right-sizing; no CIS or security-posture docs found.

Chkk.note: Upgrade and operational-risk focus (guardrails, API deprecations, misconfigurations, EOL); no security/CIS, cost or service map found.

rows.label: What each finding does NOT establish
rows.full: Findings name the Kubernetes objects they rest on and state explicit claim limits

Shoalcheck.note: every finding states its own claim limits beside the claim

Kubescape.note: Failures list affected resources; scan-level coverage names skipped controls and why. No per-finding claim limits found.

Trivy.note: Results carry Namespace/Kind/Name and a message naming the object; no claim-limit statements found.

Popeye.note: Report lists issues per scanned resource; no claim-limit statements found.

Kubecost.note: Recommendations name workloads/volumes, sometimes hedged ('possible'); no per-finding claim-limit statements found.

Komodor.note: Violations tie to a workload/cluster with runtime evidence and guidance; no per-finding claim limits found.

Chkk.note: Risks list affected resources; assessments say they are planning-grade without pre-verification. No per-finding claim limits found.

rows.label: Dollars with their price basis
rows.full: Cost findings in dollars with price basis; unpriced shown as unpriced, never $0

Shoalcheck.note: every figure names its list-price basis; unpriced is shown unpriced, never $0

Kubescape.note: Searched README, docs and control library for cost/pricing: nothing. Security-only scope.

Trivy.note: Searched Kubernetes target, reporting and CLI docs: no cost or pricing features.

Popeye.note: Reports CPU/memory over/under-allocation against metrics-server; no dollar figures found.

Kubecost.note: On-demand pricing unless CSP data says otherwise; reconciled to the bill; unreconciled marked. Unpriced handling not documented.

Komodor.note: Dollar allocation from cloud pricing by instance type, region, lifecycle; unpriced handling not documented.

Chkk.note: Only frames EOL alerts as avoiding extended-support surcharges; no per-finding dollar figures or price basis found.

rows.label: Preflight: drain, zone, upgrade
rows.full: Preflight before a change: node drain (PDB) feasibility, zone-loss stranding, upgrade blockers, with exit codes

Shoalcheck.note: can this node drain, what a lost zone strands, what blocks an upgrade — with exit codes

Kubescape.note: No drain/PDB, zone-loss or upgrade-blocker checks found. Adjacent: C-0273 outdated version; `predict pss` for PSS enforcement.

Trivy.note: Deprecated/removed-API check (KSV-0107; operator 'outdated api validation'). No drain, zone-loss or target-version analysis found.

Popeye.note: Lints: no PDB, PDB minAvailable above running pods, deprecated API groups, old K8s. No per-node drain/zone/target-version checks.

Kubecost.note: Searched node-group sizing, savings and proactive cost controls: right-sizing only; no drain, zone or upgrade preflight.

Komodor.note: Daily-scan violations: EOL versions, deprecated APIs, suggested target; SPoF only after runtime impact. No drain/zone preflight or exit codes.

Chkk.note: Deep upgrade safety: next-minor assessments, PDB misconfigs, pre/post-flight checks, digital-twin preverification. No per-node drain or AZ-loss feasibility.

rows.label: CI gate that refuses what it can't compare
rows.full: CI gate: compares with a baseline, fails on new high-severity findings/regressions, refuses incomparable comparisons

Shoalcheck.note: fails on new high findings; refuses a comparison across clusters or engine versions

Kubescape.note: `scan --baseline --baseline-fail-on-new`, `diff --fail-on-new --severity-threshold`; cross-context results flagged incomparable, not refused; no engine-version check found.

Trivy.note: `--exit-code` with `--severity` fails builds on any finding; no baseline comparison in OSS docs.

Popeye.note: Non-zero exit on lint errors; `--min-score` threshold. No baseline comparison found.

Kubecost.note: Cost-prediction GitHub Action compares PR vs base-branch manifest cost and fails on cost thresholds; not audit findings.

Komodor.note: New KAOP module gates release candidates on standards and flags regressions vs previous run; no comparability rules found.

Chkk.note: Docs suggest running assessments weekly in CI to publish readiness; no failing gate or baseline comparison found.

rows.label: SARIF for code scanning
rows.full: SARIF export for GitHub/GitLab code scanning

Shoalcheck.note: SARIF 2.1.0 for GitHub and GitLab code scanning

Kubescape.note: `--format sarif` for GitHub Code Scanning; also a `gitlab-sast` format.

Trivy.note: SARIF exists for image/filesystem/repo scans, but `trivy k8s` allows only table, json, cyclonedx.

Popeye.note: Documented outputs: standard, jurassic, yaml, html, json, junit, prometheus, score. No SARIF.

Kubecost.note: Searched IBM Kubecost 3.x docs navigation and Helm chart README: no SARIF output.

Komodor.note: Searched help-center article index and KAOP full docs export: no SARIF.

Chkk.note: No SARIF mention anywhere in Chkk's full docs export.

rows.label: Agent MCP with no cluster access
rows.full: MCP server for AI agents to query findings, with no cluster access itself

Shoalcheck.note: shoalcheck-mcp answers from readings and cannot reach the cluster

Kubescape.note: MCP server bundled in the CLI, but it reads CRDs and runs live scans with your cluster credentials.

Trivy.note: Official trivy-mcp plugin scans filesystems, images and remote repos; no cluster-findings tools documented.

Popeye.note: Searched README, docs and releases (latest v0.22.1, Jan 2025): no MCP server.

Kubecost.note: Beta, read-only MCP for cost/savings data; deployed in-cluster with the Helm chart (OpenCost also ships one).

Komodor.note: Beta hosted MCP (enabled via CSM) exposes health risks and violations, plus Klaudia RCA and remediation actions.

Chkk.note: Preview Risk Feed MCP reads risks from Chkk's API via a cloud identity, no kubeconfig in setup; can trigger remediation.

rows.label: Tickets with de-duplication
rows.full: Pushes findings as Jira/Linear tickets with de-duplication across pushes

Shoalcheck.note: ticket push to Jira/Linear with a dedup marker that stops a second filing

Kubescape.note: ARMO Platform (ARMO's SaaS), not the OSS CLI: manual per-finding Jira ticket linked to the finding, optional auto-close; Linear listed.

Trivy.note: OSS results go to kubectl/CRD/Prometheus; notifications and incident-management flows are Aqua commercial only.

Popeye.note: Searched README and docs: no Jira/Linear or other ticketing integration.

Kubecost.note: Alerts go to Email, Slack and Microsoft Teams; no Jira/Linear integration found.

Komodor.note: KAOP lists Jira and Linear integrations; workflows can open tickets. Classic help center lists no Jira; de-dup not documented.

Chkk.note: Per-risk 'Create Ticket' action to Jira; no Linear or de-duplication documented.

rows.label: Signed, single-file report
rows.full: Single-file, signed, offline HTML report / evidence pack

Shoalcheck.note: one signed HTML file / evidence pack, offline

Kubescape.note: HTML and PDF report formats; metadata hide/encrypt options; report signing not found.

Trivy.note: HTML via template and Cosign-signed scan records exist for image/fs scans; not for `trivy k8s`.

Popeye.note: HTML report output (can be saved to S3); signing not found.

Kubecost.note: Saved reports emailed on a schedule as PDF or CSV; signing not found.

Komodor.note: Only a table export button and an email digest found; no report file or signing.

Chkk.note: Assessments downloadable as Markdown files; no HTML report or signing found.

Shoalcheck.note: shoalcheck fleet, one HTML across clusters

Kubescape.note: CLI `--kube-contexts` fleet scans (v4.0.13+) with combined fleet report and cross-cluster divergence (v4.0.15+); ARMO Platform also multi-cluster.

Trivy.note: Vendor comparison lists Trivy OSS Kubernetes scope as single cluster; multi-cluster is Aqua commercial.

Popeye.note: One context per run; per-cluster Prometheus metrics feed a sample Grafana dashboard with a Cluster selector.

Kubecost.note: Unified multi-cluster view is an Enterprise feature; Free is per individual cluster.

Komodor.note: SaaS platform spans all connected clusters; cost and reliability views group across clusters.

Chkk.note: SaaS inventory and risk ledger span many clusters and clouds.

note: Each competitor cell is that vendor's own documentation, fetched 2026-10-20. “not in their docs” is said as that, not as “they can’t”. Kubescape’s 2026 v4 releases overlap several rows; re-checked 2026-10-20.
caveats: Kubescape moved fast in 2026: `diff` (by v4.0.10, Jun), `scan --baseline` and `--kube-contexts` fleet scans (v4.0.13, Sep), fleet report (v4.0.15), scan-coverage reporting (v4.0.9+). Rows 6/11 rest on CLI help, repo docs and release notes; kubescape.io pages do not describe them yet.
Kubescape OSS vs ARMO Platform: Jira/Linear ticketing and the hosted multi-cluster UI are ARMO SaaS features, not the open-source CLI.
Trivy: `trivy k8s` is labelled EXPERIMENTAL in its docs; multi-cluster scope, notifications and incident flows are Aqua commercial features.
Popeye looks low-activity: latest release v0.22.1 (Jan 2025), last commit Apr 2025.

Kubecost is now IBM Kubecost; docs.kubecost.com redirects to ibm.com, which blocks scripted fetches, so those pages were read in a headless browser. MCP is beta (3.3+); the unified multi-cluster view is Enterprise-only. OpenCost (free) also ships a built-in MCP server.

Komodor has two doc sets: the classic Kubernetes platform (help.komodor.com) and the new Komodor Agentic Operation Platform, KAOP (docs.komodor.com). Row 6 and the Jira/Linear evidence come from KAOP. Klaudia MCP is beta and enabled per account by a CSM. help.komodor.com and komodor.com block scripted fetches; read in a headless browser.
Chkk analyses data in its SaaS (CLI uploads collected resources); Risk Feed MCP is preview-only; CLI output is Markdown with JSON described as coming.

'not found' means not found in the docs searched on 2026-10-20, not proven absent. Example: Kubecost and Komodor do not document how unpriced resources are shown, so the 'unpriced, never $0' sub-claim cannot be contrasted.
Verdicts come from vendor documentation only; no competitor product was installed or run. Plan/pricing gates (ARMO, Aqua, Kubecost Enterprise, Komodor, Chkk) may limit features.
Quote verification: quotes from IBM and help.komodor.com pages were checked against the browser-rendered text; all other quotes were string-matched against the fetched page text.
